title.value: Microscopy-BIDS: An Extension to the Brain Imaging Data Structure for Microscopy Data
title.justification: The paper aims to introduce an extension to the Brain Imaging Data Structure specifically for microscopy data, enhancing data organization and sharing capabilities.
title.quote:
Microscopy-BIDS: An Extension
to the Brain Imaging Data Structure
for Microscopy Data

extractions.description: The paper presents 'Microscopy-BIDS', an extension to the Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS), designed specifically for organizing, sharing, and archiving microscopy imaging data. It provides a standardized structure and metadata for various microscopy methods, facilitating multi-modal imaging analysis.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on enhancing data structure and sharing for neuroscience research, specifically in microscopy, and does not directly address climate or ecological sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: The Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) is a specification for organizing, sharing, and archiving neuroimaging data and metadata in a reusable way.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not relate directly to any category of Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development as it is centered around data structure improvements for neuroscience.
primary_category.quote: We presented a new extension to BIDS for microscopy data. Fully compatible with the BIDS specification, the extension defines file formats that are suitable for the storage of 2D and 3D microscopy data of popular modalities.

primary_sub_category.justification: Since the paper does not align with any primary category related to sustainable development, there is no applicable sub-category.
primary_sub_category.quote: Microscopy-BIDS also includes comprehensible metadata definitions for hardware, image acquisition, and sample properties.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper's focus on data structure for neuroimaging does not necessitate a new category within Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
new_primary_category.quote: The Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) is a specification for organizing, sharing, and archiving neuroimaging data and metadata in a reusable way.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: There is no need for a new sub-category as the topic is not relevant to sustainable development in the context of climate or ecology.
new_primary_sub_category.quote:
Microscopy is widely used in neuroscience to characterize
tissue microstructure and study neurological pathologies.
